modeling_decisions: Concept low centers/raised rims and connected irregular cells retained. Override approximately regular equal-size cells with clipped irregular Voronoi cells of unequal size, four-to-seven sides and broken orientations. One continuous manifold heightfield using shared cell boundary vertices, paired near-boundary elevated shoulders and thin lower contraction groove; centers remain below shoulders but above soil base. No floating tiled plates, deep mudcrack gaps, mixed high-centered cells, blue lakes, snow or plants. Side cut surfaces close full terrain volume.
